workouts.title: KPUP 1.1 (Week 1, Workout 1)
workouts.description: Welcome to Kipping Pull-Up Performance! We’re kicking things off by testing your current kipping skills. Don’t worry if you can’t do one yet, today is simply about seeing where you’re starting from so you can clearly track your progress over the next 8 weeks. To help, download and print the Kipping Pull-Up Performance Score Sheet from the Files tab. Even if your score is zero, that’s a valuable starting point. You won’t know how far you’ve come unless you know where you began. If you’re a WODprep Academy athlete, post your test video in the Academy Coaching space to get personalized feedback from our coaches. Not an Academy athlete but want coaching? Reach out to us at support@wodprep.com.

items.movement: Use the Kipping Pull-up Score Sheet to track your score. Set ends when you drop from the bar.

workouts.title: KPUP 1.2 (Week 1, Workout 2)
workouts.description: A good benchmark for kipping pull-ups is a 1:3 ratio, for every strict pull-up you can do, you’ll likely be able to perform five kipping pull-ups. That’s why today we’re testing your strict pull-up strength after running through some shoulder stability drills. You’ll see these movements often throughout the program, because healthy shoulders are key to safe, efficient kipping. Building this foundation now will pay off in a big way later.

items.movement: Set ends when you drop from the bar. Track your results on the Kipping Pull-up Score Sheet.

workouts.title: KPUP 1.3 (Week 1, Workout 3)
workouts.description: Hard to believe we’re already at the end of Week 1! Today is all about dialling in the basics: the arch and hollow positions. The foundation of every kipping movement. Start slow, stay in control, and focus on quality. We’ll finish with a quick core test using hollow rocks. This will give you a baseline to compare against later in the program. Expect a good burn, your core is what ties the kipping pull-up together!

workouts.title: KPUP 2.1 (Week 2, Workout 1)
workouts.description: Shoulder health is essential. Building a full expression of strength, mobility, and stability will help you feel strong and pain-free as you move through the program.

items.movement: Strict Bar Hanging Hollow to Arch

workouts.title: KPUP 2.2 (Week 2, Workout 2)
workouts.description: Let’s dial in some focused work on your kipping pattern today. Be sure to video your movement during the final set of the EMOM and either share it for coaching feedback or use it for your own review. The more input you get early in the program, the faster and more effectively you’ll improve. Don’t miss the opportunity to refine your technique!

items.movement: 5 x Beat Swing + 5x Kip Swing + 1-2 Kip Swing with Re-grip
Video final set of minute 2 for review

workouts.title: KPUP 2.3 (Week 2, Workout 3)
workouts.description: Developing control at the top of the kip will drastically improve the timing and position through your kipping pattern. Today is all about timing, positions and core. Have fun!

workouts.title: KPUP 3.1 (Week 3, Workout 1)
workouts.description: One of the biggest challenges in the kipping pull-up is the push away at the top of the kip. Without it, you fall straight down and usually need a “double kip” to get going again. Nailing this part sets you up perfectly for fluid, consistent reps.

items.movement: No rig to attach to the band to? Do Banded Pull Aparts
10-20 x Banded Straight Arm Lat Pulldown
Strict Bar Hanging Hollow to Arch
10sec x Chin Over Bar Hold + Push Away

workouts.title: KPUP 3.2 (Week 3, Workout 2)
workouts.description: Think of your midline like a hose, any kinks mean lost power. Keeping your body aligned and activated prevents energy leaks and helps everything work in together. Today we’re attacking that with drills to build midline stability and core stamina.

workouts.title: KPUP 3.3 (Week 3, Workout 3)
workouts.description: Double whammy today! We’re dialling in our kipping positions and building strict pull-up strength. Two essential pieces, one solid session. Go after it with focus and intensity!

items.movement: Pronated Strict Pull-up + Hold for 1 sec + Push Away
Pronated Strict Pull-up + Hold for 1 sec + Push Away
Pronated Strict Pull-up + Hold for 1 sec +Push Away
Want more challenge? Increase your hold time at the top of the pull-up

workouts.title: KPUP 4.1 (Week 4, Workout 1)
workouts.description: Take your time with the first piece, your shoulders should feel primed and ready to go. As we move into kipping work, focus on hitting each position with intention and staying smooth through your transitions. Grab your Week 1 test score sheet, it’s time to revisit the Hollow Rock Test and see how your core strength and endurance are shaping up!

items.movement: Strict Bar Hanging Hollow to Arch

workouts.title: KPUP 4.2 (Week 4, Workout 2)
workouts.description: Aside from a 3 set check-in on strict pull-up strength, it’s a light day for the hands with a focus on core activation and control.

items.movement: Set ends when you drop from the bar.

workouts.title: KPUP 4.3 (Week 4, Workout 3)
workouts.description: You’ve crushed the first half of the Kipping Pull-up Performance course and today, we’re putting that hard work on display! Be sure to video all three Max Kipping Pull-up sets for personal review or to share with a WODprep Coach in the Academy Coaching Space. If you’ve made it this far and feel like you could use more personalized support, don’t hesitate to book a complimentary discovery call. It’s a great way to find out if 1-on-1 Coaching is the right move to help you reach your goals faster and with more confidence.

items.movement: Pronated Strict Pull-up + Hold for 3 sec + Push Away
Pronated Strict Pull-up + Hold for 3 sec +Push Away
Pronated Strict Pull-up + Hold for 3 sec + Push Away
Want more challenge? Increase your hold time at the top of the pull-up.
Set ends when you drop from the bar

workouts.title: KPUP 5.1 (Week 5, Workout 1)
workouts.description: Today we’re focusing on serious time under tension. You’ll start with Chin-over-Bar holds, then flow directly into a kipping pull-up. While the set calls for holds up to 30 seconds, most athletes will land in the 5–15 second range and that’s totally fine. Focus on quality positioning and control.

items.movement: 60 sec x Skin the Cat Stretch
Up to 30sec x Chin Over Bar Hold + Push Away + 1 x Kipping Pull-up
Accumulate 1 minute in as few sets as possible

workouts.title: KPUP 5.2 (Week 5, Workout 2)
workouts.description: The fundamentals are always worth revisiting. Today, we’ll flow through all the key positions needed to knock out big sets of kipping pull-ups. Don’t rush these but focus on quality movement and control in every rep. We’re also introducing a Supinated Pull-up (aka Chin-up) negative. Control the descent as much as possible, especially near the bottom range. That’s where the real strength gains are made.

sections.name: SKILLS
sections.notes: 3-5 Supinated Pull-up Negative (5 second negative) Rest walk 30sec between each pull-up attempt Rest walk 1 minute

workouts.title: KPUP 5.3 (Week 5, Workout 3)
workouts.description: Lots of positional work on deck today. Slow things down, stay focused, and hit every shape with intention. Your future kip will thank you.

items.movement: Pronated Strict Pull-up + 5sec Chin Over Bar Hold + Push Away + Kipping Pull-up
Pronated Strict Pull-up + 5sec Chin Over Bar Hold + Push Away + Kipping Pull-up
Pronated Strict Pull-up + 5sec Chin Over Bar Hold + Push Away + Kipping Pull-up
Want more challenge? Increase your hold time at the top of the pull-up
Kipping Pull-ups with a 2sec hold at the top of each rep

workouts.title: KPUP 6.1 (Week 6, Workout 1)
workouts.description: We are getting strong! Here is another opportunity to work on that strict strength. The complex at the end of the day is spicy. Manage your reps well and aim for unbroken sets.

items.movement: Strict Bar Hanging Hollow to Arch
Pronated Strict Pull-up + Push Away + 3 x Kipping Pull-up
Want more challenge? Increase the number of pull-ups you can maintain across all sets with good form.

workouts.title: KPUP 6.2 (Week 6, Workout 2)
workouts.description: It’s a nice, easy day on the hands today! If you’re looking to increase the challenge, feel free to add more time under tension during the EMOM (for example, try a 45-second Superman Hold instead of 30). Just make sure you leave yourself enough time to transition smoothly into the next movement.

items.movement: 30sec x Strict Bar Hanging Hollow to Arch
20sec x Left Prone Thoracic Rotation + 20sec x Right Prone Thoracic Rotation
30sec x Banded Straight Arm Lat Pulldown
Short on time? Do 1-2 rounds instead of 3.

workouts.title: KPUP 6.3 (Week 6, Workout 3)
workouts.description: Today we’re tackling top-end reps under fatigue so after the Kipping Pull-ups with a 2-second hold, you’ll go straight into a max unbroken kipping set with whatever ‘juice’ you’ve got left. It might be 10, it might be 0, just give your best effort and focus on all the positional work you’ve built so far. And of course, if your hands are feeling close to ripping, don’t hesitate to call it a day. Protect your hands so you can stay consistent and strong heading into the home stretch.

items.movement: Pronated Strict Pull-up + 10sec x Chin Over Bar Hold + Push Away + 3 x Kipping Pull-up
Kipping Pull-ups with a 2sec hold at the top of each rep

workouts.title: KPUP 7.1 (Week 7, Workout 1)
workouts.description: Let’s keep the momentum going with some strict and kipping pull-up complexes to build volume and control. Stay focused, stay tight, and earn every rep!

items.movement: Strict Bar Hanging Hollow to Arch
Pronated Strict Pull-up + Push Away + 5 x Kipping Pull-up
Modify the reps as needed to complete the full moment unbroken
Accumulate 1 minute in as few sets as possible

workouts.title: KPUP 7.2 (Week 7, Workout 2)
workouts.description: Fundamentals are the foundation of every movement and today we’re putting in the work to strengthen them. If the 60sec holds are a little much, feel free to modify or break them up until you’ve accumulated the full minute. Focus on quality over perfection.

items.movement: Strict Bar Hanging Hollow to Arch

workouts.title: KPUP 7.3 (Week 7, Workout 3)
workouts.description: Final session before test week, let’s go big on volume. Protect those hands. Earn that recovery!

items.movement: Pronated Strict Pull-up + 5sec x Chin Over Bar Hold + Push Away + 2 x Kipping Pull-up
Pronated Strict Pull-up + 5sec Chin Over Bar Hold + Push Away + 4 x Kipping Pull-up
3 x Kipping Pull-ups with a 2sec hold at the top of each rep

workouts.title: KPUP 8.1 (Week 8, Workout 1)
workouts.description: Welcome to Week 8 of Kipping Pull-up Performance, you made it! That alone speaks volumes about your focus and commitment. Remember, your consistency matters far more than any number you write on your score sheet today. There’s a lot of pulling in today’s session, so feel free to scale back the skill work if needed to protect your hands for the test. Take care of them, they’ve worked hard, too. Use your Week 1 score sheet and film your strict pull-up test so you can compare your test results to Week 1.

items.movement: Video and record each set for Week 1 comparison

workouts.title: KPUP 8.2 (Week 8, Workout 2)
workouts.description: Time to show your shoulders some love after that strict pull-up test. Go slow, stay focused, and treat this like the maintenance work it is, it’ll pay off. Before our final kipping test next session, we’re revisiting the Hollow Rock test. Let’s see how much stronger your core has gotten over the last 8 weeks!

items.movement: Strict Bar Hanging Hollow to Arch

workouts.title: KPUP 8.3 (Week 8, Workout 3)
workouts.description: Today is our final day of Kipping Pull-up Performance! For some, today test might be a new PR. For others, it could be improved shapes or stronger positions. No matter what your numbers look like, we’re proud of all your effort and success! We want to hear all your your success! Post your before-and-after videos on the Wall of Wins and earn yourself with some sweet WODprep swag just for sharing.

items.movement: 15sec Hollow Body Hold + 15sec x Superman Hold
Video both sets and share your success on the Wall of Wins!
